lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Import a Collector project and record each layer account, remote id and managed origin
Corrupt or remove one vector R-tree file, then cold-open the project and run sync
Return 404 for one managed layer while it is still referenced by the project snapshot
Remove layer_origin and that layer's ngw_identity_backup from one otherwise valid legacy-style config, then reopen and sync
Create a second physical layer with the same account and remote id, then run composition sync
value.expected: Cache repair preserves NGW identity; a managed 404 does not convert the layer to local; one unowned physical match is adopted without redownload; an ambiguous duplicate identity records local_identity_conflict, blocks composition apply and never creates another layer.
